R1.description: Deterministic milestone/<work-item-id> branch naming and creation from the configured trunk

R2.description: Durable Controller-side branch evidence; restart never duplicates a branch, switches to an unrelated branch, force-resets or rewrites a milestone branch

R3.description: A Controller-owned GitHub boundary (gh) instead of shell commands scattered through lifecycle logic

R4.description: Draft PR from the milestone branch to trunk, identity persisted and recovered, matching PRs reused, ambiguous or mismatched identity refused

R5.description: Human-only merge; the PR is marked ready only after every precondition is verified

R6.description: Lightweight trunk semantics: no develop branch, concurrent milestone branches possible, not every trunk merge releases

R7.description: Trunk drift is detected and never treated as equivalent to the integrated result; the history-preserving integration primitive exists; Workflow 2.5.1 behaviour is a fail-closed gate

R9.description: A generic repository release policy separated from the Controller's reference configuration

R10.description: pyproject.toml is the single Controller version authority; package metadata, --version, wheel and release validation agree; source runtime never reports an installed version

R11.description: A push to trunk releases exactly when the authoritative version changed, after validating the transition

R12.description: The tag is derived from the version and created only after validation, at the exact validated commit, and never moved

R13.description: An immutable GitHub Release with the verified wheel and checksums, published by one deterministic main-branch transaction

R14.description: Explicit release collision and recovery states; a correct tag with an incomplete release resumes; a wrong-commit tag fails closed

R15.description: CI keeps fail-fast false, same-ref cancellation for pull requests, narrow write permissions and SHA-pinned write-path actions

R16.description: Controller 1.1.x compatibility: no behaviour change without an admissible policy; packaged-runtime isolation preserved

R17.description: inspect/explain/status surface branch, PR, drift and release-policy state derived from durable records; follow unchanged

R18.description: Disposable-repository and fake-forge coverage of every listed scenario, and operator documentation
